cards.user_need: Repair an invoice quote so a customer credit is applied once after unit charges and shipping, with checked signed i64 arithmetic.
cards.public_api: Keep quote.pricing.quote(units, unit_price, shipping, credit) and pricing::quote with four signed i64 arguments and signed i64 result.
cards.completion_criteria: All representable values equal checked units*unit_price + shipping - credit; any overflowing intermediate fails. Both language conditions use the same cases.
cards.hidden_cases: Zero, independent nonpublic positive and negative values, signed credits and shipping, multiplication overflow, and intermediate addition overflow.
cards.edge_cases: Negative units and credits; mathematical final value can fit even when a checked intermediate does not.
cards.seed_data_provenance: Deterministic handwritten arithmetic cases in private/accept.py; no external dataset, random seed, or model trace. The starter and reference overlays were generated by generate.py from fixed literals.
cards.substantive_reason: The change must preserve a public four-argument API and checked intermediate behavior across a three-module dependency chain; matching the published 824 example alone does not pass.

cards.user_need: Repair a 20-module energy quote graph so each of 14 component charges contributes exactly once through four groups to the total.
cards.public_api: Preserve component charge APIs, each group charge API, and grid.quote.total / quote::total for signed i64 usage.
cards.completion_criteria: Each component applies its documented rate once; group rates are 28, 49, 83, and 121, total rate 281, using checked signed i64 arithmetic.
cards.hidden_cases: Nonpublic positive and negative usage, each group independently at multiple usage levels, zero, and checked overflow.
cards.edge_cases: Group totals can look correct at one published usage while individual paths or other usage values are wrong; large usage must fail rather than wrap.
cards.seed_data_provenance: Fixed rates in generate.py's LEAVES table and deterministic handwritten arithmetic cases in private/accept.py; no external dataset, random seed, or model trace.
cards.substantive_reason: The repair traverses four aggregation modules among a 20-module graph and must preserve 14 public component functions and checked behavior; copying the public total of 2810 does not satisfy group or hidden usage checks.
